# Parley v0.1.8

This beta replaces Parley's external terminal-multiplexer architecture with
retained native Ghostty panes and moves coordination into the application
process. The result is a more responsive workbench with independent input,
selection, copy and scroll behavior across every pane.

## Native Ghostty panes

- Every shell, Claude Code, Codex, Agy and Copilot pane is now one retained
  Ghostty terminal surface with its own real PTY and process.
- More than four panes retain independent keyboard and mouse input without the
  shared-focus failures of the old tmux-backed preview.
- Native split layouts, selected-pane borders, pane identity and balance
  actions make the active surface clearer.
- Terminal font family and size are configurable once for every current and
  future shell and agent pane.
- Closing or hiding the main window keeps live panes running while Parley
  remains open. Explicit pane/workspace close, Stop Everything and full quit
  terminate their exact processes.

## App-resident coordination

- Relay, Ask, Answer, Delegate, Status and Wait now use one coordination core
  embedded in the Parley app rather than a separate executable or login item.
- Pane-scoped credentials and capability-named endpoints continue to establish
  the real sender and preserve explicit, authenticated targets.
- Multiline delivery uses one Ghostty paste followed by a separate Enter event,
  retaining each vendor CLI's own TUI and permission flow.
- Status Center reports the embedded terminal, coordination lifecycle and
  durable collaboration records without inferring hidden vendor state.

## Workspaces and interface

- A workspace is now durable identity independent of folders and can have zero
  or more explicit folder attachments plus an optional New Pane Folder.
- New Workspace creates a folderless collaboration container; folder-first
  opening remains available and resolves explicit attachment matches.
- Existing pane working directories remain pane-local when workspace
  attachments change, and folder metadata never grants agent permission.
- The workbench, workspace menu, activity chrome, Status Center, collaboration
  history and terminal settings have been streamlined around the new model.
- Obsolete tmux, SwiftTerm, standalone-core, login-item, attached-runtime and
  vendor-conformance implementations have been removed.

## Upgrade notes

- Parley no longer requires tmux. The app bundle contains one executable and
  embeds Ghostty as its only terminal renderer and PTY owner.
- Agent protocol v9 removes the old tmux-specific instruction. Existing agent
  panes with an older stamp must be restarted once before agent-to-agent
  actions are enabled.
- Workspace definitions and local collaboration history remain under
  `~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`. A full quit cannot preserve a
  vendor conversation; agent panes reopen as stopped placeholders.

## Install and trust

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- At least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.8-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it normally from Finder.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings >
  Privacy & Security > Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.8-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
